_comment: Identity corrections for the CWL 2017-2019 archive (Activision cwl-data). Owner-editable. 'players' maps archive spellings to canonical handles (the archive title-cases stylized gamertags); 'teams' merges names the archive uses inconsistently for the same team. Archive spellings are preserved in player_aliases. 'orgs' is a different thing from 'teams': it groups distinct branded identities under one organisation so a rebrand keeps one rating curve. Membership is only asserted where the two brands' series windows do not overlap — a concurrent second roster is an academy team, not a rebrand.
